anchor.quote: Let $k$ be the number of axes.
Let $m_i$ be the length of the $i$-th axis
Let $N = m_1 m_2 \cdots m_k$ be the number of coefficient positions.

gaps.term: preservation of the convolution along several axes
gaps.quote: which is why the convolution is preserved
gaps.note: The page asserts that the relabeling preserves the cyclic convolution and gives only the one-sentence wrap-around reason. It never defines a convolution over several cyclic axes, so the reader cannot check that the sums of the original convolution correspond to sums over the axes.
